parsed_json.up: Select the ChEMBL ID, preferred name, maximum clinical phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES for all compounds reported in the specified document. Join docs to compound_records on doc_id, then to molecule_dictionary on molregno, and inner join compound_structures on molregno to require structures. Filter by the document ChEMBL ID. Return rows ordered by molecule ChEMBL ID ascending.
